march.note: Haslametrics' algorithmic 'deserves' forecast emphasizes results and résumé. It is a projection, not the NCAA committee's bracket. Region groupings here are illustrative.

notes.players: Season lines from ESPN's player stats feed (minutes, shooting, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, turnovers, PER). True shooting and effective field-goal percentage are computed from those totals.
notes.games: Scores are timestamped ESPN snapshots, refreshed periodically. Haslametrics supplies additional future fixtures.
notes.rankings: Haslametrics and BPI measure team strength differently. Strength of Record measures résumé. Haslametrics quadrant records are based on its own hNET, not official NCAA NET.
